jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(F) inventory: Thetford Town School District, a town school district in the Orange East Supervisory Union (member town: Thetford). Operates PK-6 (Thetford Elementary); grades 7-12 attend Thetford Academy, the designated approved independent school.

board.post_note: Thetford Town SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot under the town charter (24 App. V.S.A. section 123A-201(e)), on a mix of 2- and 3-year terms. One seat's holder is unestablished (see the sources).

sources.note: Thetford board page, Orange East SU site (official, current; fetched 2026-10-22): four members -- Cook (Chair), term 2024-2027; Chin, term 2026-2028; Necheles, term 2026-2027; Sargent, term 2025-2028. The Town of Thetford Elected Officials list shows a FIVE-seat board and publishes Jamele (to 2026) and Hareld (to 2026), both absent from the current roster -- recorded ended 2026; the fifth seat's current holder is established by no fetched official source (possibly vacant; resolving document: the March 3, 2026 TTSD return). FLAGS: Chin's end conflicts between the town list (2027) and the district's own OESU page (2028) -- the OESU page controls as the post-election district source; Necheles's one-year term matches neither regular seat class (2- and 3-year) and reads as a vacancy remainder, undocumented.
